bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 4, 11, 12. PROFITABELLE will begin her second campaign when she makes her home track debut today. She's trialed twice recently with Tommy Berry aboard on both occasions and her unplaced latest effort before her spell must be ignored. There were excuses! BLESSED EAGLE was spelled after two trials back in March. He looked the part with Tim Clark aboard in the second of two much more recent trials and this race is within his reach on debut. WATSON'S BAY presents on debut after trialing twice recently at Randwick and this class suits at his first start. ARTEMEX resumes at home after two trials. He will be competing as a gelding for the first time and he can return as an improved three-year-old.

raceTips.comment: The lightly raced Profitabelle is perfectly placed resuming over the 1100m with the in form jockey on board, will settle off the genuine early speed and saved for one sprint at them late. Artemex hit the line strongly when resuming last preparation and if able to reproduce the rating from that run will figure in the finish, maps to enjoy a soft run stalking the leading pair throughout. Expecting competitive debut performances from Blessed Eagle & Watson's Bay over the suitable 1100m with both trialling well leading in.

QUEEN'S GAMBLE has handed in two solid efforts in defeat since a spell at Canterbury with Tommy Berry aboard on both occasions. bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 4, 5, 6. COLUMBUS had looked the part first up at Newcastle before he finished unplaced as an odds-on favourite at Rosehill last start. The addition of blinkers creates the chance for him to atone today. DEEP PLEASURE must be forgiven for a Kensington track defeat after she struck trouble last start and the addition of blinkers is expected to now aid her cause. NAMASTE was produced third up within this distance range at Canterbury last start when gear changes were made. He kept trying after he struck traffic problems and he returns to home base today with scope to improve. JOHN DORY became unsuited in transit from a wide gate last start at his Rosehill home base. He is more suitably placed today from an inside barrier.

raceTips.comment: Columbus has shown enough ability in his recent preparation to make his presence felt here, with the gelding capable of settling closer from the favourable draw. He has the turn of foot to put himself into contention and should appreciate a genuine tempo. Namaste has been racing consistently and possesses the tactical speed to settle just behind the leading runners. He can conserve his energy before being produced at the right time. John Dory has plenty of upside and should be able to settle in a handy position. He looks capable of making his presence felt if he gets clear running in the straight. Deep Pleasure has shown glimpses of ability and can improve with the benefit of another run under his belt. He will need to find a few lengths late but is capable of doing so

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 3, 9, 11, 12, 14. LULL had been kept fresh before she looked the part over this journey last start at Canterbury in a Race that's produced outstanding form. She will present fresh again today when she now makes her home track debut. STRIKING ALIBI is an imported filly who makes an Australian debut after trialing twice last month at Randwick. She's more than ready to tackle this trip first up. BUBBLES UP begins her second campaign today after trialing twice at Rosehill. bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 3, 5, 7, 11, 14. MR MILLER scored here on debut before there were excuses for subsequent defeat at Randwick and then at Gosford. He now begins his second preparation after trialing twice with James McDonald aboard at Randwick. This race is within his reach. PHANTOM MAJOR was presented for the second time in his first campaign when he scored with authority after a twenty-two day break at Canterbury. He should have more to offer after this quicker back-up when he now makes a Warwick Farm debut. SOCIABLE kept trying in defeat after he struck trouble at Wyong. A return to home base can be regarded as a plus today. MAZIS also resumes today. He won his lead-up trial at Tamworth and he shouldn't be underestimated first up, aided by the claim for Braith Nock.

raceTips.comment: The talented Mr Miller is perfectly placed resuming this preparation over the 1400m, the gelding has looked sharp at the trials leading in and gets a soft run throughout from the good draw with James McDonald on board. Sociable was good through the line over 1300m last start and would have taken further improvement off that performance, drawn perfectly and the in form jockey jumps on board.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 4, 11, 12, 13, 14. VALILEE was partnered by Mitchell Bell when he won two recent trials. Tackling this trip should now be ideal, making a metropolitan debut. MANUKAU resumes after trialing twelve days ago with Tim Clark aboard at Rosehill. He's proven over this short journey and his first up Hawkesbury effort last preparation was even better than it reads on paper. FIERCE presents first up after two trials in August. He was a Wyong winner first up over this trip last campaign and history can repeat when he now makes a Warwick Farm debut. GENEROUS HARRY was presented first up when he led throughout over this journey at Wyong. He was a second up Gosford winner over this trip last campaign and this race is also within his reach. SPARTUS can cause his own problems with a poor getaway but even so, he's been produced here once and over this trip, his effort was full of merit in a race that produced strong form.

raceTips.comment: Rantan was strong through the line over 1000m last start and with general improvement off that performance will be fighting out the finish, maps to get a soft run just off the leading group with the benefit of a 3kg claim. Valilee is perfectly placed resuming and with the superior early speed in the race will find the front to dictate the tempo to suit.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 7, 10, 13. THE LITTLE GENERAL was too good for all except the winner at Canterbury last start and he was only third up on the day. He can be expected to at least maintain his form when he now makes his Warwick Farm debut. HEROIC DEED scored with great authority first up over this distance at Newcastle and he should have more to offer when he now makes his Warwick Farm debut. OLIVIA TWIST was resuming when her effort was game at Canterbury in a race that's produced excellent form and she can add to the depth of that form after her subsequent Rosehill trial. ROYAL AIR FORCE refused to shirk his task in defeat at Canterbury after he struck a traffic problem in the same race contested last by OLIVIA TWIST. He's been kept fresh since and he has raced well within this distance range fresh before.

raceTips.comment: Silencio Porfavor brings a strong overall profile into this event and looks suited by the way the race maps. He can settle just off the speed before producing a sustained finish and has the quality to take control late. There is an in-form jockey on board, which adds further confidence to the selection. The Little General has been holding his form well and should enjoy a comfortable run near the leaders. He has enough speed to put himself into the race and will give a good account in the straight. Couples Retreat is another capable runner who can settle midfield and work into the race gradually. He possesses a solid finishing burst when produced at the right time. Heroic Deed has the ability to run well with the right race shape. He will need to find cover early and produce his best acceleration when the gaps appear.
